Point P is located on the right side of the figure and is surrounded by an unlabeled closed isotherm; near it, there is a 20℃ isotherm above and a 16℃ isotherm below. Reasoning: The question stem states that the temperature at P is abnormal due to the influence of topography, and asks for the “relatively high temperature value that may occur.” Interpreting it as a relatively high anomaly, the closed isotherm outside P can be regarded as the 20℃ isotherm, and the inside of the closed line is a high-temperature center. Among possible values, a value that is relatively high but does not reach 24℃ can be taken as 23℃.

<image1>

推理：题干说明P处因受地形影响气温出现异常，要求“可能出现的较高气温值”。按照较高异常来理解，P外围的闭合等温线可看作20℃等温线，闭合线内部为高温中心。由于图中下一条更高的等温线是24℃，而P处闭合区域内没有达到或标出24℃等温线，所以P点气温范围应为20℃<T<24℃。在可能值中，较高但未达到24℃的值可取23℃。
